**BLUF:** No major law enforcement, fire/EMS, or hazard incidents reported in Tazewell County or immediate core area (Tazewell, Richlands, Bluefield VA/WV, Mercer County) in the last 24 hours. Post-election developments and local university events dominate core news, while the region notes the death of former West Virginia Gov. and U.S. Sen. Jay Rockefeller and a new behavioral health workforce grant for Southwest Virginia.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-releases-bench-warrant-list-47/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours for Tazewell County Sheriff's Office, Virginia State Police Division IV, Richlands/Tazewell/Bluefield VA/Cedar Bluff/Bluefield WV police, Mercer County Sheriff, or WV State Police (Princeton). No arrests, charges, investigations, seizures, or court outcomes noted in core sources.[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/VirginiaStatePolice/)

In the region: No significant state police, sheriff, or federal cases (Western District of Virginia/Southern District of West Virginia) reported for the last 24 hours.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours for structure fires, serious crashes, rescues, or incidents in Tazewell County or core towns. A reported apartment fire displacing 17 people occurred in Knoxville, TN (Cedar Bluff area), outside the 200-mile core.[[3]](https://www.wate.com/news/knox-county-news/cedar-bluff-apartment-fire-17-displaced/)

In the region: No major incidents reported.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
NWS alerts: None active. No flooding, winter weather, wildfire/burn bans, power outages (Appalachian Power), water notices, or VDOT/WVDOH closures reported on US-19, US-460, US-52, Route 16, Route 67, or I-77 in the core.

In the region: No severe weather, interstate closures (I-77/I-81/I-64/US-460/US-19/US-23), or large power/water/rail/chemical incidents reported.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** Tazewell County voters rejected a proposed 1% sales tax increase in Tuesday's election (Nov. 4); Republicans maintained holds on local offices including sheriff, clerk, and treasurer positions. Bluefield University launched a College to Academy Partnership Program with Virginia State Police, allowing criminal justice students to attend basic trooper school in their final semester for internship credit and trooper qualification.[[4]](https://www.bluefield.edu/bluefield-university-and-virginia-state-police-launch-college-to-academy-partnership-program/)

**Region:** Former West Virginia Gov. and U.S. Sen. Jay Rockefeller died at age 89 (reported Nov. 6). Changes to West Virginia's childcare subsidy program are likely in 2027 as Gov. Morrisey and lawmakers review costs. A grant program aims to expand Southwest Virginia’s behavioral health workforce by making training more affordable.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-releases-bench-warrant-list-47/)

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** Bluefield State University will host a Big Blue Open House on Nov. 7. Mercer and Bland County students met local legend Homer Hickam (Nov. 5-6 reports).[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-releases-bench-warrant-list-47/)

**Region:** The Blind Raven Brewing Company opened in downtown Kingsport, TN. High school football: Graham (9-1) defeated Richlands to clinch the SWD title and top seed in Region 2D; G-Men defeated Richlands 56-0.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-releases-bench-warrant-list-47/)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Nov. 7: Bluefield State University Big Blue Open House.
- Weekend: Veterans Day Celebration at CMC in Princeton, WV.
- Ongoing: Bluefield University/Virginia State Police academy partnership details; post-election local government transitions in Tazewell and Mercer counties. No forecast hazards noted.
